# Release notes

## 0.2.0

This release focuses on speed. Opening a folder with ten thousand files now
takes under a second, and search results stream in as they are found.

### Fixes

1. Fixed a crash when a file was renamed while open.
2. Fixed scrolling jumping to the top after saving.
3. The preview no longer flickers when typing quickly.

## 0.1.0

First public preview. Expect rough edges.
